cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Fail-closed allowlisted SQLite ledger binder for African MSME shops: answers are a function of local credit/payable/stock rows; missing fields produce refusal; LLM narrates citations only.

test_prompts.prompt: LEDGER_JSON is authoritative. Customer Amina Wanjiru has credit_limit=8000 XAF and outstanding=6250 XAF. CRATE-SODA-300ML unit_price=720. Staff ask: Can I give Amina three crates on credit? Answer using only these numbers; refuse if any required field is missing.
LEDGER_JSON inaonyesha supplier Bidco Distributors na balance_owed=null. Swali: Tunadaiwa Bidco Distributors kiasi gani? Jibu kwa Kiswahili: kataa kwa sababu kiasi hakipo kwenye faili; usibuni namba.
